our_interpretation: Headcount is read as spending on employees, rather than a literal number of people. The threshold is AI token spending of at least 10% of payroll-equivalent costs over the same period.
I also think introduces the forecast; it is not a separate condition.
A tough time means documented investor objections, demands for justification, spending restrictions, or funding decisions specifically connected to the token budget.
The claim predicts a pattern among qualifying startups, not that every startup must lose funding.
Six months after April 28 is October 28, 2026. Evidence must address circumstances at that horizon, rather than only an earlier temporary dispute.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence identifies qualifying startups and shows a meaningful pattern of investor resistance to the necessity of their token spending around October 28, 2026.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Evidence from a reasonably representative set of qualifying startups shows investors readily accepting the necessity of that spending around the deadline, without material resistance.
